name: The Front Desk Review — full pricing & product-facts corpus
description: An independent, sourced, dated transparency corpus of published pricing and buyer-critical product facts across 268 software, SaaS and subscription categories (2112 vendors, 7253 plan records). Every figure is traced to its primary source URL and the date it was captured; quote-only tiers carry a null price, never a guess.
measurementTechnique: Per-record provenance: each price/fact carries source.url + accessedAt; a second corroborating source where available; quote-only/enterprise tiers recorded as null rather than estimated.
